# Runtime compatibility fixture

`runtime-tdx-zero-rtmrs.json` contains a synthetic signed TDX quote and its
synthetic Intel and Sigstore collateral. All RTMRs are zero, allowing the
runtime-only check to exercise the IGVM register policy. Its legacy provenance
also endorses those registers so the normal client verifier can independently
validate the fixture before the test supplies embedded runtime references.

The test checks successful runtime compatibility, incorrect runtime digest and
measurement rejection, and full config-hash rejection for the same quote.
The synthetic roots and fixed appraisal time are available only in the
`tinfoil_conformance` build. They do not change production trust.

Regenerate with `generate.py` and the `fixturegen/` source from
`tinfoilsh/tinfoil-conformance` commit
`781b08b1300ccdea49bf0cdb2bd6bd3acae6d2a3`:

```sh
python3 -m venv /tmp/tinfoil-collateral-fixture-venv
/tmp/tinfoil-collateral-fixture-venv/bin/pip install cryptography==50.0.2
/tmp/tinfoil-collateral-fixture-venv/bin/python generate.py /path/to/conformance-source
```

Generation reuses the shared quote/certificate signing library. Fresh synthetic
Intel keys make the generated bytes vary; the declared policy and test behavior
are stable.
